why: Cast Dragon Fodder. This creates two 1/1 red Goblin tokens that I can attack with alongside my Bonebreaker Giant. Total damage output this turn: 4 (Giant) + 2 (tokens) = 6 damage if unblocked, bringing opponent to 3 life. After combat, they'll attack with 6 damage (Rumbling Baloth + Grizzly Bears), likely killing me at 5 life, but maximizing this turn's damage gives me the best chance to find a winning path or reduce them to a critical life total.
